name: icons-01

args.prompt:
Use the attached first-eight board ONLY as our own material, lighting and contour reference. Replace the board with the NEW complete layout below; do not preserve or repeat the original eight objects. Create original distinct inventory objects for the established brass-clockwork roguelite. Match this described first-eight material vocabulary: richly modeled old golden-brass rims and rivets; dark blue-grey gunmetal recesses; small bright cyan/teal inset lenses; wood is warm brown with broad quiet grain, leather matte; clean dark contour and restrained warm upper-left highlights. Crisp fine pixel clusters, broad 2–3 value planes, no fuzzy airbrush/no photoreal objects/no vector pictograms. The first-eight silhouettes were U-shaped bell magnet, short heavy gun barrel, wooden heart-lock chest, three-lobed returning rotor, three compact drones, pear-shaped electric urn, triple hanging clock-tooth tuning fork, asymmetrical pendulum. Do NOT draw those eight again: the sixteen objects below need their own silhouettes. UI displays each at52px so do not rely on tiny engraving or color alone. No text, IDlabels, numbers, rarity borders, frames, scenery or floor shadows. Truly transparent background everywhere outside each object, no checkerboard artwork, colored haze, stray alpha or baked glow cloud. No copying outside-game IP. Keep all objects separated.
ONE square transparent sprite sheet, exactly FOUR equal columns by FOUR equal rows,16objects total. Requested square1024x1024; actual returned source may be a different square size and must be measured, never auto-crop. Each full object fits within the CENTRAL50percent of its cell width and height; leave25percent of every cell fully transparent on ALL FOUR SIDES. No object crosses a cell or bleeds into its neighbor. Keep object scale visually equal and comparable to the first-eight board; do not expand narrow small hardware to fill a square. Render in row-major order as follows:
Row1, column1: B05, 疾鸣撞针. 窄长弹簧撞针，前端分叉火帽.
Row1, column2: B22, 扩震钟环. 厚环形爆震钟圈，三个外翻共振齿.
Row1, column3: B29, 薄钟长管. 细长双节枪管，远端开口如小号.
Row1, column4: B31, 敲钟重锤. 偏心方头铜锤，短柄与凸起撞钉.
Row2, column1: P03, 术式增幅石. 被三段黄铜夹爪固定的棱形术石.
Row2, column2: P08, 穿响音叉. 细长穿甲音叉，双齿之间一枚细弹.
Row2, column3: P23, 奇点余振环. 悬浮黑心奇点环，三颗不对称铆钉.
Row2, column4: P31, 刻风膛室. 侧开三室膛体，背后三枚上扬风叶.
Row3, column1: P33, 恒辉折镜. 宽扇折光镜，三块错角镜面.
Row3, column2: P34, 连奏梭轮. 三孔梭轮，右侧单个突出计数齿.
Row3, column3: B07, 定脚支架. 三脚折叠射击支架，宽底小顶.
Row3, column4: B08, 止滑钟靴. 带齿鞋底的短筒钟靴，鞋尖上扬.
Row4, column1: B23, 尾摆齿环. 带尾梢的开口齿环，尾端一片铜摆叶.
Row4, column2: B28, 逐风鞋簧. 靴跟外置S形发条，朝右的明确鞋形.
Row4, column3: P12, 刃影回纹. 三道错位新月刃片穿过回纹框.
Row4, column4: G01, 微核回响. 薄铜耳片包着一颗偏心微型发光核.

admission: Independent reviewer final_review explicitly permitted ONLY four remaining64 icon boards and selected two static16resource boards after realUI/world/frame-sequence golden. New output remains unverified.
